> **Early release.** Jellyfin Decoder has been tested on desktop only, not yet on a headset or a Quest, and may contain bugs. It needs a Jellyfin server you can reach. The software is provided **as is**, without warranty of any kind. Jellyfin and its logo belong to the Jellyfin project; this mod is not affiliated with or endorsed by it.

Install: put `xenu.jellyfin-{version}.zip` in your RetroXR data folder under `mods/` (`~/retroxr/mods/` on desktop).
